headline: Executive order sets up a committee to advise the federal government on quantum science research.
what_it_does: This order creates the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee. Based on the title, the committee's job is to give outside advice on the federal government's National Quantum Initiative, a research effort in quantum science and technology. The title alone does not give details on who serves on the committee or exactly what it reviews.

who_it_affects.group: Quantum science researchers in universities, industry, and government labs
who_it_affects.how: People from these fields may be chosen to serve on the committee or have their work shaped by its advice.
Agencies running quantum research programs may receive recommendations from the new committee.
